claims: Treat hyperglycemia with scheduled insulin therapy and monitor fingerstick glucose closely, given multiple glucose readings above 180 mg/dL.
Replete low serum potassium with potassium chloride and recheck serum potassium, given potassium 3 mEq/L.
Monitor for delirium and reassess mental status, given positive CAM-ICU features (inattention, disorganized thinking) and fluctuating GCS/orientation.
Continue maintenance intravenous NaCl 0.9% at 50 mL/hour and monitor electrolytes.
Assess and manage pain, given a reported pain level of severe (8).

Monitor arterial blood pressure closely, given recent systolic pressures 110-147 mmHg, diastolic 49-58 mmHg, and mean 68-89 mmHg.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status on 2 L/min oxygen, given SpO2 94-95% and respiratory rate 15-22/min.
Perform bladder scanning for urinary retention, given bladder scan estimates of 268 mL and 535 mL.
Obtain urinalysis to evaluate for infection, given leukocytes 17.1 K/uL and urinalysis findings.
